macros.title: Colossus AFK
macros.instructions:
Before Starting

• Select any R Class vehicle.
• For the best credit earnings, we recommend using a Forza Edition vehicle with a Credits Boost bonus.
• Expected earnings are approximately 600,000 Credits per hour for standard players and up to 1,200,000 Credits per hour for VIP players.

Required Driving Assists

• Drivatar Difficulty → Unbeatable
• Braking → Anti-Lock Off
• Steering → Simulation
• Traction Control → Off
• Stability Control → Off
• Shifting → Manual

Macro Controls

• F8 → Start
• F2 → Pause or Resume
• F9 → Stop

macros.title: SP Farm
macros.description: Automatically repeats the recommended EventLab Challenge to farm Skill Points.
macros.instructions:
Before Starting

• Select the required Subaru vehicle before starting the macro.
• Using another vehicle may prevent the macro from earning the expected 9–10 Skill Points per run.

Required Driving Assists

• Drivatar Difficulty → Unbeatable
• Braking → Assisted
• Steering → Auto-Steering
• Traction Control → On
• Stability Control → On
• Shifting → Automatic

Challenge Setup

1. Open the Race menu.
2. Select EventLab.
3. Select Play Challenges.
4. Choose a compatible Skill Point challenge.

Recommended Share Code

• 140 849 306

The newer July 15 "Always Win 2" version from the same creator may also be used. Both versions complete in approximately 21 seconds and are compatible with the macro.

Macro Controls

• F8 → Start
• F2 → Pause or Resume
• F9 → Stop

macros.title: Keep Duplicate FE Cars
macros.description: Spins normal and Super Wheelspins while keeping duplicate Forza Edition cars.
macros.instructions:
Before Starting

• Open the My Horizon menu before starting the macro.
• Make sure you have normal Wheelspins or Super Wheelspins available.

How This Version Works

• Automatically opens both normal Wheelspins and Super Wheelspins.
• Keeps duplicate Forza Edition vehicles.
• Other duplicate vehicles are handled automatically by the game and macro flow.

Use this version when you want to keep duplicate Forza Edition cars instead of selling them.

Macro Controls

• F8 → Start
• F2 → Pause or Resume
• F9 → Stop

macros.title: Sell Duplicate FE Cars
macros.description: Spins normal and Super Wheelspins while automatically selling duplicate Forza Edition cars.
macros.instructions:
Before Starting

• Open the My Horizon menu before starting the macro.
• Make sure you have normal Wheelspins or Super Wheelspins available.

How This Version Works

• Automatically opens both normal Wheelspins and Super Wheelspins.
• Automatically sells duplicate vehicles, including duplicate Forza Edition vehicles.

Use this version when you want to automatically sell all duplicate cars for additional Credits.

Macro Controls

• F8 → Start
• F2 → Pause or Resume
• F9 → Stop

macros.title: Lamborghini Revuelto
macros.description: Processes Revuelto vehicles for 1 Super Wheelspin and 3 normal Wheelspins per completed vehicle.
macros.instructions:
Before Starting

• Enter the Garage and open any section of the main Garage menu.
• Make sure you have enough Credits to purchase the required vehicles.
• Make sure you have enough Skill Points available for each Car Mastery tree.

Recommended Vehicle

• Lamborghini Revuelto
• This is the recommended Car Mastery vehicle for players using the base game.
• Each completed vehicle provides 1 Super Wheelspin and 3 normal Wheelspins.

The macro automatically purchases the vehicle, opens its Car Mastery tree and spends the required Skill Points.

Macro Controls

• F8 → Start
• F2 → Pause or Resume
• F9 → Stop

macros.title: Mazda DLC Pass
macros.description: DLC Pass route that processes Mazda vehicles for 1 Super Wheelspin per completed vehicle.
macros.instructions:
Before Starting

• Enter the Garage and open any section of the main Garage menu.
• This version requires ownership of the applicable DLC or Car Pass.
• Make sure you have enough Credits to purchase the required vehicles.
• Make sure you have enough Skill Points available for each Car Mastery tree.

Required Vehicle

• Mazda Mad Mike
• This is the recommended Car Mastery vehicle for players who own the required DLC Pass.
• Each completed vehicle provides 1 Super Wheelspin.

The macro automatically purchases the vehicle, opens its Car Mastery tree and spends the required Skill Points.

Macro Controls

• F8 → Start
• F2 → Pause or Resume
• F9 → Stop
